title: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs
slides: Meta launches an open-weight AI model that runs on Macs. Why?
You can now run advanced AI locally on your laptop.
This model matches proprietary giants on many tasks.
Test it with your own sensitive data, no cloud needed.
Download and run a local AI model today.
thread_text:
1. Meta's Quiet Power Move

Meta just released an open-weight AI model that runs directly on Macs — no cloud, no subscription, no data leaving your laptop.

2. The Local AI Leap

You no longer need a server farm. This model runs on everyday hardware, putting advanced AI in your backpack.

3. David vs. Goliath

On many benchmarks, it goes head-to-head with closed models like GPT-4. But you own the weights, not a license.

4. Your Data, Your Rules

Run it on private documents, medical records, or legal contracts. Nothing gets sent to a third party. Ever.

5. Try It This Week

Download the model from Meta's repo, load it on your Mac, and ask it one question about a sensitive file. Does that change how you work?

instagram.caption:
Advanced AI now runs directly on your Mac, no cloud required. 🖥️

Meta released an open-weight model that runs locally on everyday laptops.

On many tests, it matches closed giants like GPT-4.

You download the weights, you own them — no license, no subscription.

For anyone handling sensitive files, this means you can query private documents, contracts or medical records without sending a byte to a third party. 🔒

So the real question: what's the first confidential file you'd test it on this week? 💾
